documents.notes: Derived poor-scan fixture. The logical document benchmarked here is the image-only PDF at fixture_path, produced deterministically by evals/generate_degraded_fixture.py (seed=42, dpi=110, quality=20) from the original text source at corpus_path. Text extraction from the fixture is empty by construction, so paginas_esperadas in golden.jsonl reference fixture pages (1-18) and the evidence audit translates them to source pages via page_map before reading corpus_path. sha256/page_count describe the fixture; source_sha256 describes the original source.
